about: Quality tiers, chosen before the plan. The runner fills any field the config leaves out from the tier (models, effort, budgetUsd per step, maxFixLoops, gates, research, planCritique, depth); a field the config states itself wins. maxSkills is read by /setup-pipeline (skills per step), not by the runner. effort: low | medium | high | xhigh | max. research: none | github (up to 3 popular repos) | deep (up to 5, compares architectures and licenses). depth: standard | thorough (extra edge-case tests when building, mutation-style questions when reviewing).

economy.label: Economy
economy.about: Plan written from the spec alone (no outside sources), token-saving plugins, minimal suggestions. Cheapest.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.about: Plan informed by popular GitHub repositories on a similar topic. Opus plans, Sonnet builds and reviews, Haiku commits, at high to xhigh effort; plugins that keep tokens in check.

premium.label: Premium
premium.about: Best result, cost is not the concern. Deeper research on popular repositories, a longer plan with a second critique pass, xhigh to max effort, strict quality gates, extra edge-case tests and a mutation-style review. Build and Review run on Opus or Sonnet, your choice.
